notes.note: 11 marks for Houston helped his score as well as his 20 disposals. Still not the level we need from him as most of the ball went through Josh Daicos this week.
Houston continues his up and down scoring season with a poor one this week from his 12 kicks and 5 handballs. He didn't have the same impact he had last game.
Best from Houston since round 8 with 28 disposals and 11 marks. We won't expect this regularly as the Pies took control after quarter time against the Tigers.

We were told that Josh Daicos would spend more time in the middle leaving more defensive ball for Houston and he had 12 kicks and 7 handballs but his score was still a sub 90. Many teams may have to hold as they run out of trades.
Houston struggled to score yet again and with the bye this week you can certainly look at upgrading him as he is going to lose value with a BE of 92 which is going to make it tough to keep him.
Much better from Houston this week with 23 disposals at 87%. This was his best score since round 8. We need more of this from him but he is likely to be traded at their bye.
Just 13 disposals for Houston in what was his lowest score of the season. This is a real concern for owners as his BE rises and his value drops. If you want to trade him it may not be a bad option.

Houston played a bit of second fiddle to Josh Daicos with just 17 disposals at 64%. This was his lowest since round 5. The small ground can slow the scoring of some of the outside runners that aren't used to it
Houston had a quiet first half but came home with 56 points in the second half. We need him to keep this as his floor.  He improved his output after Moore was ruled out.
This was possibly the best game we have seen from Houston at Collingwood. 32 disposals and 7 marks. First back to back over 100 weeks for him.
27 disposals and 8 marks for Dan with this his second best score. He is bouncing around with his scoring as we see different strategies in that Collingwood backline.

Houston was better but still not delivering the big scores we were seeing early in the season. He is still a hold though as there are plenty of other things we should do first like upgrading those rookies.

Houston dropped back to the low scoring that we were worried about. Just the 14 disposals and 7 marks. With the Blues this week we are hoping that he can bounce back on the MCG in better weather conditions
Houston was the only Pie over 100 this week and a great bounce back this week which also coincided with Darcy Moore out of the side again. Nothing to worry about with him.

Oh no what have we done. Houston was heavily traded in this week after starting the season so well but the reintroduction of Howe seems to have hurt him as he posted just 18 disposals and 5 marks down from the 28 and 32 of his first two games.
Many thought Houston's score last week was a one off but he really seems to have a great role and the Pies like the footy in his hand as Josh Daicos is now up the ground more. Jump on after his bye.
Houston showed a much better level of score than what we saw last year. He also didn't have any forward pressure on him as he and Josh Daicos did as they pleased. Just temper your expectations.
